- After you place the first instance at the goal receptacle, make retrieving the next instance your immediate next sub-goal: navigate back to that same source location and take the remaining instance there, rather than resuming a broad search sweep or re-checking unrelated locations; this return to the known source takes precedence over any general instruction to resume or broaden the search sweep while that source is known to hold the remaining instance.
- Do not abandon or re-sweep past the source location while it still offers an additional instance of the required object; only widen the search for the remaining instance if the source location no longer shows the expected instance.
- Keep the existing locate-take-deliver ordering and continue until the required number of instances has been placed at the same goal receptacle instance that received the first; this retrieval priority applies only during the acquisition/retrieval phase and does not add extra transforms or intermediate stops.
